description: The basic things of a Castellan world: people, trees, stones, what people can know, and the first pieces of a mind.

Person.description: A person's body in the world. Their mind and knowledge are edges to shared nodes.

determination.description: How strongly they stick with what they are doing (ADR-0016).

Tree.description: A tree; a source of wood.

wood.description: Units of wood it can give.

Sighting.description: A claim that something was seen at a place and time (ADR-0015).

subject.description: Id of the node that was seen.

asOf.description: World time (days) the sighting was made.

Survive.description: Stay alive: flee danger, eat, drink, keep warm.

Shelter.description: Having a safe place to sleep.

Explore.description: Walk toward the unknown to learn what is there.

knows.description: A person holds a claim. The person's side carries when and how they learned it.

has.description: A person has a need, goal or trait; their personal value sits on their end.
